datasets.name: ARIL

settings.scenario: Six hand gestures at sixteen labeled indoor locations

datasets.name: CSI-Bench
datasets.summary: Large-scale in-the-wild benchmark spanning seven WiFi sensing tasks, commercial edge hardware, real homes, and continuous natural activity.

hardware.platform: Commercial routers and IoT edge devices

settings.scenario: Homes, offices, and public indoor areas; in the wild

original.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 on Kaggle; repository text should be checked per release

standardization.notes: BreathingDetection samples use the vital-sign profile (10 Hz, 60 s; rate assumed when not reported). Other CSI-Bench tasks should use general-sensing when added. Keep official splits and multi-task labels.

conversion_example.note: The official MAT key X is retained and a link axis is inserted when needed.

datasets.name: CSIDA
datasets.summary: Cross-domain gesture dataset providing original and processed CSI together with gesture, environment, location, and person labels.

settings.scenario: Six gestures at five locations across two rooms

conversion_example.note: Keep csi_data_pha and all csi_label_* Zarr arrays beside csi_data_amp.

datasets.name: EHUNAM
datasets.summary: Multi-campaign WiFi CSI dataset for people counting, human activity, identity, appliance recognition, and industrial machine activity across days and environments.

hardware.platform: Raspberry Pi 4 transmitter and multi-receiver arrays

settings.scenario: Three campaigns over 23 days, including five human scenarios, appliances, and an industrial laboratory

standardization.notes: Preserve campaign, day, environment, receiver, person-count, and machine-state domains for cross-domain evaluation.

conversion_example.note: Null carriers are removed from the CSI/BW/Subcarriers metadata.

datasets.name: Exposing the CSI
datasets.summary: Large modern-WiFi experimental collection designed to study how bandwidth, MIMO, spectral resolution, hardware, and environment affect sensing.

settings.scenario: Multiple controlled experiments varying WiFi configuration, collectors, target positions, and sensing conditions

original.license: Zenodo record terms; verify per archive

standardization.notes: Treat bandwidth, MIMO mode, collector, position, and experiment as explicit domain fields rather than collapsing them.

conversion_example.note: The adapter FFT-shifts AX-CSI, removes official null bins, and deinterleaves four monitor streams.

datasets.name: WiFi CSI HAR (Three Rooms)
datasets.summary: Packet-level CSI with activity intervals and person bounding-box labels collected across three rooms and multiple sessions.

settings.scenario: Walking, sitting, standing, lying, getting up/down, and no activity across rooms

collection.device: TP-Link TL-WDR4300 (Atheros CSI Tool), 2×2 MIMO Tx/Rx
collection.distance: A few metres between transmitter and receiver inside one room

labels.activity: walking · sitting · standing · lying · get_up · get_down · no_person

collection.scenario_labels: Rooms: room_1 / room_2 / room_3 · multiple capture sessions per room
collection.subcarrier_spacing: 312.5 kHz (standard 40 MHz OFDM; inferred, not stored in release)
collection.sampling_rate_hz: Not reported in release (general-sensing view assumes 100 Hz)
collection.clip_length: Continuous packet stream (hosted sample: 5200 packets); view clips to 3 s
collection.scenario: Three furnished rooms at Ukrainian Catholic University

standardization.notes: Task profile: 100 Hz, 3 s for HAR clips. Preserve room/session hierarchy, convert interval labels into temporal segments, and keep native MIMO link/subcarrier counts.

settings.description: Hold out one of the three rooms.

conversion_example.note: Keep label.csv beside data.csv so activity labels are attached automatically.

datasets.name: Contactless Activity and Localization

standardization.notes: Preserve both activity and spatial-zone labels for joint and single-task protocols.

conversion_example.note: The official CSV contains processed USRP-OFDM CSI amplitude.

datasets.name: 5G-enabled Multi-user Presence and Activity
datasets.summary: Open SDR-based wireless CSI dataset covering sixteen combinations of occupancy and simultaneous activities for assisted living.

hardware.wifi_standard: Custom OFDM rather than commodity WiFi

settings.scenario: Empty room and activity combinations with up to four people

standardization.notes: Tag as SDR-OFDM CSI, not commodity WiFi CSI, while sharing the canonical tensor representation.

conversion_example.note: The class directory is retained as source-label provenance.

datasets.name: MM-Fi
datasets.summary: Synchronized WiFi, RGB-D, LiDAR, and mmWave data with action and pose annotations for daily and rehabilitation activities.

hardware.platform: TP-Link N750 access points and synchronized sensor platform

settings.scenario: Daily and rehabilitation actions in two rooms and four platform settings

datasets.name: NIST BreatheSmart CSI
datasets.summary: Government open data containing raw real and imaginary WiFi CSI for controlled respiratory-motion experiments with a breathing manikin.

settings.scenario: Anatomically correct breathing manikin under controlled respiratory motion

conversion_example.note: Keep the matching imaginary log and config0001.csv in the same directory.

datasets.name: NTU-Fi HAR and Human-ID
datasets.summary: Paired Atheros-platform benchmarks for six-class human activity recognition and gait-based identification of fourteen people.

settings.scenario: Segmented activities and gait identity recordings

original.license: Processed benchmark access via linked cloud storage; verify dataset terms

standardization.notes: Published benchmark representation is amplitude-only; do not imply that raw complex CSI is available.

conversion_example.note: SenseFi's time-axis downsampling and canonical transpose are applied.

datasets.name: OPERAnet
datasets.summary: Synchronized complex WiFi CSI, UWB, passive WiFi radar, and Kinect dataset for activity recognition and localization.

hardware.platform: Three Intel NUC devices plus RF and vision sensors

settings.scenario: Daily activities and natural movement in two rooms

conversion_example.note: The 270 tx/rx/subcarrier MATLAB-table fields are ordered deterministically.

datasets.name: SignFi
datasets.summary: Fine-grained sign-language recognition dataset collected from WiFi CSI in laboratory and home environments.

settings.scenario: 276 sign-language gestures in lab and home settings

standardization.notes: Access requires accepting dataset terms; preserve lab/home domain and user splits.

settings.description: Preserve Home276, Lab276, Lab+Home276, and Lab150 release groups.

conversion_example.note: Complex CSI and lab/home labels are retained.

datasets.name: UT-HAR
datasets.summary: Widely used seven-class clip-level WiFi CSI benchmark containing daily activities and falls.

settings.scenario: Controlled single-person indoor activities

standardization.notes: Verified on the official SenseFi X_test/y_test pair. Values are upstream processed amplitude features and can be negative; no phase, timestamp, or physical power is invented.

conversion_example.note: Keep UT_HAR/label/y_test.csv beside the data/ tree; these .csv files contain NumPy binary payloads.

datasets.name: Wallhack1.8k
datasets.summary: Open raw WiFi packet and spectrogram dataset for presence and activity recognition in line-of-sight and through-wall settings.

hardware.platform: Two WiFi systems with BQ and PIFA antennas

settings.scenario: LoS and NLoS/through-wall; no presence, walking, walking plus arm waving

collection.device: ESP32-S3 CSI (BQ biquad + PIFA antenna systems)
collection.subjects: Not reported as subject IDs (single-person activity recordings)
collection.scenario_labels: NLoS room: 0 = none; 1–5 = room index · LoS / NLoS hallway and through-wall paths
collection.subcarrier_spacing: 312.5 kHz (standard 20 MHz OFDM L-LTF; inferred, not stored in release)
collection.scenario: LoS hallway path and through-wall NLoS across adjacent offices

original.license: Open Zenodo record; verify file license metadata

standardization.notes: Task profile: 100 Hz, 3 s. Parse interleaved imaginary/real values, select documented L-LTF or HT-LTF subcarriers, and retain scenario/antenna labels. Keep native link/subcarrier counts.

datasets.name: WiAR

datasets.name: Widar3.0

datasets.name: WiFi CSI and RSS Presence/Movement

datasets.name: WiFiTAD

datasets.name: XRF V2
datasets.summary: Multimodal continuous daily-activity dataset for temporal action localization and action summarization in smart-home rooms.
